Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.game.Game
public class Game extends Object
Aggregate root representing a single game session and all of its mutable state.

A Game bundles together the participating players (PlayerContext), the shared Board, the NotificatorCenter driving card-effect triggers, the current turn counter and the active GamePhase. It applies the State pattern: the player actions (addPlayer(String), placeTotem(Player, char), takeCard(Player, String)) are not implemented here but delegated to the current phase, which validates them and decides the resulting state transitions. Higher-level coordination across sessions (lobbies, persistence, reconnection) is handled by GameManager.

The game can be serialised to a GameSnapshot and rebuilt from one, enabling the crash-recovery flow orchestrated by GameManager.

    • toSnapshot

      public GameSnapshot toSnapshot()
      Captures the full state of the game into an immutable snapshot.

      The board is included only once it exists; during WaitingForPlayersPhase the board has not been created yet, so a null board is stored instead.

      Returns:
      a GameSnapshot describing the current game state

    • fromSnapshot

      public static Game fromSnapshot(GameSnapshot snapshot)
      Rebuilds a complete game from a snapshot, restoring players, board, phase and turn.

      After reconstructing the state, the strategies of every player's buildings are re-registered on the NotificatorCenter: building effects listen for triggers, so without re-registration they would never fire again after a reload (character effects are immediate and need no registration).

      Parameters:
      snapshot - the snapshot describing the persisted game state
      Returns:
      the reconstructed Game
